lines.en: I look three times per step and move slowly.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌贴地，几乎没有声音。
lines.en: My soles hug the ground, nearly silent.

lines.zh: 我绕着岩石堆，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I loop around the rock pile, circle after circle.

lines.zh: 我低着身子，从灌木底下穿。
lines.en: I keep low and slip beneath the brush.

lines.zh: 碎石在我脚边滚开一点点。
lines.en: Gravel shifts a little under my feet.
I stop and let the wind pass first.

lines.zh: 我贴着崖壁走，那里最暗。
lines.en: I walk against the cliff; the shade is deepest there.

lines.zh: 我拖着脚走，像不想被发现。
lines.en: I shuffle as if I don't want to be found.
I look back twice.

lines.zh: 我沿着水痕绕过这块地。
lines.en: I follow a water stain around this ground.
I sniff the ground with every step.
I stay perfectly still and pass for a stone.
I've waited so long my legs stiffened.
I count how many times the wind comes.

lines.zh: 我在阴影里蹲着，很舒服。
lines.en: I crouch in the shade; it suits me.
My fingers loosen slowly.

lines.zh: 我盯着一只虫子走出去。
lines.en: I watch a bug walk away.
I press my face to the stone.

lines.zh: 我没有动，连呼吸都压住。
lines.en: I don't move; I even hold my breath.
My leaf droops.

lines.zh: 石头后面的声音，我在听。
lines.en: I'm listening to the sound behind the rocks.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了半寸，又退回去。
lines.en: I creep half an inch forward, then back.

lines.zh: 我用手掌擦掉脸上的土。
lines.en: I wipe the dirt off my face with a palm.
I shrink back behind the stone.

lines.zh: 我一直在看你，你没发现。
lines.en: I've been watching you; you never noticed.

lines.zh: 你走了三步，我才动了一下。
lines.en: You took three steps before I moved at all.
Your back is easy to pick out.
I'm in no hurry; I'm more patient than you.

lines.zh: 你停下的时候，我也停下。
lines.en: When you stop, I stop.
I'm behind the stones.
Whichever way you go, I've noted it.
Your boots land heavy.
You think no one's here.
I'm waiting for you to turn around.
You're sweating; I can smell it.
I'm small, so you don't see me.
I'm working out the best moment.
You glanced this way.
Once I move, I stop hiding.
Your shadow reaches me first.
I'll wait a little longer.
Now you know — too late.
I grunt and shrink behind the stone.
I prop myself on the cliff and rise slowly.
The blow rolls me over.

lines.zh: 血滴在石头上，颜色很浅。
lines.en: Blood drips on the stone, pale.
I grit my teeth and stay silent.
I take one more look at you.

lines.zh: 栽培人不会喊疼，只会更凶。
lines.en: A Saibaman doesn't cry out — it gets meaner.

lines.zh: 这一拳，我的种子身体裂了。
lines.en: That punch cracked my seed-grown body.
Set it on the ground.
I'm not coming out, and I won't eat.
That smell is too obvious.
You're trying to lure me out.
I don't move; I wait.
You've been holding that up for a while.
I'm missing nothing.

lines.zh: 你把口袋翻出来也没用。
lines.en: Emptying your pockets won't help.

lines.zh: 我不吃陌生人给的东西。
lines.en: I don't eat what strangers offer.
Leave it there and walk away.

lines.zh: 你撞到石头，我就在旁边。
lines.en: You hit the rock, and I'm right beside it.
I slide past your legs.
You squeeze me out of my hiding spot.
My shoulder hits your knee.

lines.zh: 我们挤在同一条窄路上。
lines.en: We're jammed on the same narrow path.

lines.zh: 你退的时候踩到了我的脚。
lines.en: You step on my foot as you back off.
I'm shoved back into the cliff.
Neither of us wants to yield.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在你裤子上挂了线。
lines.en: My claws pull a thread from your trousers.
Up close, I only get quieter.
We hide together without a word.
It crouches behind another stone.
We talk with our hands.
It's better at waiting than I am.
We split into two directions.
It shows itself first; I cover it.
Our leaves touch.

lines.zh: 它看了我一眼，我就明白。
lines.en: One look from it and I understand.
We retreat into the shade together.
Silence is our language.
I hide it in a crack.
This stone sits heavy in my hand.
I reach out slowly to take it.
I pick it up and hide it behind me.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，我先看再看。
lines.en: I study what's on the ground before touching it.
I turn it over.

lines.zh: 我蹲下，把东西塞进土里。
lines.en: I crouch and press it into the soil.
This has a bit of weight.

lines.zh: 我拿了两样，就藏了两样。
lines.en: I take two things and hide both.
What you dropped, I keep.
I waited, and you came close.
I come out of the shade.
I chose this spot myself.
Your footsteps broke rhythm.
No shouting; I close in.

lines.zh: 你身后的石头挡住了退路。
lines.en: The stones behind you block the way out.
I counted your steps.
This one comes from behind.
Your shoulders just tensed.
I flatten and go in low.
Now you have two choices.
I won't miss.

lines.zh: 栽培人的小个子，锁住了那股气。
lines.en: This little Saibaman has locked onto that ki.
Behind these stones is where it starts.
Did you hear that? That's me.
I close in, pausing at every step.
You look back; I freeze.
I've moved behind three stones.

lines.zh: 你的路线绕不过这块岩壁。
lines.en: Your route can't skirt this cliff.

lines.zh: 我在你后面，隔了两块石头。
lines.en: I'm two stones behind you.
The more you rush, the more you'll misstep.
I'm listening to your breathing.

lines.zh: 你影子偏了，说明你在转身。
lines.en: Your shadow shifted; you're turning.
I'm waiting for your foot to sink in loose dirt.
You hunt for a way; I make no sound.
I've cut the gap to one pace.
You've stopped looking back.
I'm just off your rear flank.
One step more and I strike.

lines.zh: 你的喘气声帮我数着距离。
lines.en: Your gasping measures the distance for me.
I stay in your blind side.
Five more steps.
I spring onto your shoulder from behind.
My claws land before you turn.
I bite into your belt.
You didn't see this one coming.
I strike and duck back behind stone.

lines.zh: 我在你膝盖上划了一道。
lines.en: I leave a line across your knee.
Your leggings caught some of it.
I spring a second time.
I'm too close for your swing.
Light hits, but there are many.
I clamp onto your ankle.
Your missed kick makes a lot of noise.
I smile, and it's ugly.
You back into the stone.
Now you should understand.
I'm not stopping yet.
I appeared from behind the rocks.
The soil stirred and I came out.
I scan the area before standing up.
This broken rock is perfect for hiding.

lines.zh: 我没有出声，连土都没响。
lines.en: I make no sound, not even the dirt.
I shake rubble off my shoulder.
The moment I appear, I find cover.
The wind passes through the crevice.
I keep my head down and walk into the shade.
This is patient work.

lines.zh: 我站好，先测了一下风向。
lines.en: I set myself and check the wind.

lines.zh: 石头堆里，多了一双眼睛。
lines.en: One more pair of eyes in the rocks.

lines.zh: 我来得安静，走得也安静。
lines.en: I came quietly and I'll leave quietly.
I dig my claws into the dirt.
I know these cliff walls well.
I hear someone walking.
I crouch low and get ready to begin.
I don't like being seen.
Fire scorches my leaf black.
I miss a step and fall from the ledge.
Rubble rains onto my back.
Light pins me in place.
Without food, I slow down.
Lightning runs down the cliff into me.
There's no stone here to press against.
